meta.name: Riso Zine
meta.notes: Primary and accent act as two riso inks: misregistered headline layers, duotone images (dark primary → pale accent, full colour on hover), price tags, marquee band and CTA in primary with on-primary text; cream paper bg stays.

issues: Critical: every [data-reveal] element starts at opacity:0 and only appears via IntersectionObserver, so the story, stats, gallery, quote, CTA and (on the stress brand) the whole product grid render as huge empty paper voids; the catalog CTA is an empty torn brown slab

Duotone looks muddy: dark source photos (hero espresso shot, black coffee bags) collapse into a flat block of brand brown with no tonal range, which kills the riso feel and the 'reveal colour on hover' payoff
Mobile hero: the photo and spinning stamp are pulled up under the headline with a negative margin, so the stamp covers the 'VOOR TERUGKOMEN' highlight and the annotation collides with the body copy
Mobile nav gets cut off mid-word ('ACCOUNT AANM') with no sign that it scrolls
Catalog header: the handwritten tagline sits on top of the dotted cut-paper circle, so it's hard to read
Hero photo has misregistration on the type but not on the image, so the riso idea stops at the headline
fixed: Rewrote reveal so content is never hidden by default: items already in view on load (including full-page renders) show at once, and items below the fold get a one-time 'press' animation when scrolled in. Fixes every empty section on both pages and both brands
Pushed the duotone tonal range (grayscale + contrast 1.32 + brightness 1.22) so dark photos keep highlights and read as two-ink riso prints, which makes the switch to full colour on hover noticeable
Mobile hero: removed the negative overlap and gave the photo collage its own space below the headline, so the stamp, tape and annotation no longer cover text
Mobile nav now fades out at the edge with an end padding, so it's clear it scrolls
Catalog: moved the cut-paper dot circle up behind the count badge and put the tagline on its own taped paper scrap so it reads clearly
Added an off-register accent 'plate' outline to the hero photo, so the image prints slightly out of register like the headline
